sa_2_succeeded.why_wrong: extract_failure()'s fallback branch (IKE up, no ESP observed) assumes rejection; it has no state for 'IKE and Child SA succeeded, no data sent yet'. No ESP packets exist in this capture because no traffic was pushed through the tunnel before capture stopped, and separately because of a macOS kernel route-install quirk logged during negotiation ('can't install route ... conflicts with IKE traffic') - a host-side limitation unrelated to the tunnel's cryptographic validity.

note: Ground truth is T2 (iked's own log + ipsecctl), never TunnelScope's own inference, per DEC-009. Both the correct diagnosis (SA1) and the genuine misdiagnosis (SA2) are recorded honestly.
